# music-core

Core of a music player: a track library and a play queue.

- `src/library.js` – `Library` (add, remove, search, sort, albums)
- `src/queue.js` – `Queue` (play order, next/previous, shuffle, repeat)
- `src/time.js` – `formatDuration`, `parseDuration`

The modules are empty stubs. Implement them so that `npm test` passes. Do not change the tests.
